title: Tweet: the NGA tracks nonstructured light-energy craft

tellings.quote: National Geospatial Agency is able to keep track of all those nonstructured light energy craft flying around the world

plain: The National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, the US agency that handles satellite imagery and mapping, is able to keep track of "all those nonstructured light energy craft flying around the world", according to a tweet that Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower, addressed to the businessman Elon Musk. Brown stands behind the tweet on the show. If true, a US agency would be quietly watching such craft worldwide.
